quarantine_risk: Quarantine breach risk dataset

Source: R/data.R
quarantine_risk.Rd

Total infection force relative to the pre-Delta unvaccinated baseline, across combinations of viral transmissibility (R0) and vaccine efficacy (VE).

Usage

quarantine_risk

Format

A data frame with 100 rows and 3 variables:

R0

Basic reproduction number, integer from 1 to 10

VE

Vaccine efficacy, numeric from 0 to 0.9

beta_ratio

Total infection force relative to the pre-Delta unvaccinated baseline (1 = baseline)

Source

Zachreson, C., et al. (2022). COVID-19 in low-tolerance border quarantine systems: Impact of the Delta variant of SARS-CoV-2. Science Advances, 8(14), eabm3624. https://doi.org/10.1126/sciadv.abm3624

Details

The values were transcribed from Figure 4 of Zachreson et al. (2022); see data-raw/DATASET.R for the preparation script. The baseline (value 1) is reached at R0 = 3 with no vaccination. The results come from simulations, so the grid contains some noise and is not perfectly monotone.
